Definition: from G971; a forcer, i.e. (figuratively) energetic:--violent.
BiblicalUsage: The violent are the forceful ones, and the word appears once, in a hard saying of Jesus. In Matthew 11:12 he says the kingdom of heaven suffereth violence, and the violent take it by force. Not violence against others, but the eager, pressing energy of people crowding into the kingdom.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jesus is describing hunger, not harm: the kingdom is taken by people who press in because they cannot stay away.
